author: Sarah Yates-formally Bowden
content:
I have been using Better Leisure Centre with my children ongoingly for 13 years, the staff have always really been extremely patient and kind to our family, which is really important to myself as a parent carer with a hidden disability, with children on the spectrum.
Since the new owners, Charlotte & James have taken over Feed, my children & myself have really noticed their commitment and support to the local people and Better community, especially the young people.
Additionally , my children enjoy their food and the staffs friendlyness so much, they have encouraged me to change from other places, to use Feed over any other Coffee provider whenever I can, when we are in the area. Which to me speaks for itself.
Fantastic ! 🙌
